facts.anchor: Two days later, the bleeding becomes spotting. Three days later, it is manageable.
facts.fact: 出血两天后转为点滴状，再过三天变得可控，她认为自己能应付。

facts.anchor: On Friday, the fourth day, Elise returns to class.
facts.fact: 到第四天星期五，Elise 回到课堂上课。

facts.anchor: “Today everyone is performing their autocours. You have something to share?”
facts.fact: Tomas 在课堂上问 Elise：今天每个人都要演 autocours，问她有没有东西可以分享。

facts.anchor: “You will not develop in this class unless you unlock that and let it out.
facts.fact: Tomas 在课后对 Elise 说：除非她打开并释放心里那部分，否则在这门课上不会有进展。

facts.anchor: “I can book my return flight now,” she says, nodding to the credit card.
facts.fact: Catherine 对 Elise 说，她下周某个时候大概会离开，现在就可以订回程机票，并朝信用卡点头。

facts.anchor: “Well, it’s not finished, but it’ll be about me,” Elise says. “My life.”
facts.fact: Elise 告诉母亲，自己要写的场景还没写完，但会写她自己、写她的生活。

facts.anchor: “Aya is not my friend. Well, not just my friend.”
facts.fact: Elise 在餐桌上对母亲 Catherine 说，Aya 不是她的朋友，或者说不仅是朋友。

facts.anchor: “I want to tell you the story of how I met your dad.”
facts.fact: Catherine 深吸一口气，对 Elise 说她想讲自己当年如何遇见她父亲的故事。
